launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.1.0 "Slate": full UI redesign inspired by the Badlion look - the mod menu is now a translucent navy slideout over the live world with search, module tiles and in-panel settings pages; teal/red state colors, steel-blue selection, flat dark buttons. Also fixes the bugged layouts: invisible header back buttons, text overflow at high GUI scales, crushed About/Create World pages, ClickGUI drawer geometry.
